items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: What are you going to do with Michael, who's older than these fellas? Oh yeah. You see, Michael read every doc you put before him.

ctx.x: He was studying music in 1900. Or he wouldn't be considered one of the best teachers down there.

Papa, I'm afraid of all of them, give him that credit. Go to Emanuel Moneta, he'll school you on the piano. He'll teach you your proper fingers. And if he wants to sit there and maybe age has got him a little bit down, but he knows all his, he's going to give you the proper execution for fingers. He can get around. See, what Duke Ellington put in his book there were no reading. What are you going to do with Tony Jackson? My God Almighty. What are you going to do with Michael, who's older than these fellas? Oh…
